Rehash-before-verification accepts an unverified password; bcrypt truncation accepts a changed suffix after its byte limit. Different defective boundary and repair.
LIKE pattern metacharacters remain interpreted inside a bound value; SQL identifier selection is a different boundary outside value binding.

No Fiber or transaction sharing occurs in the row-advancement trace. The earlier question is connection ownership across interleaving tasks.
Overlapping Fibers share one connection transaction; repeated bindParam executions observe a referenced variable. Neither repair addresses the other defect.
The memory query has no shared transaction or Fiber. Similar PDO boilerplate does not duplicate transaction ownership reasoning.

Concrete type lookup versus static state shared across object instances.
Stringable conversion under strict calls versus omitted nullable default arguments. Both use type declarations but fail at different boundaries.
PCRE array orientation and HTTP safe-versus-idempotent methods share only review phrasing, not code or a technical mechanism.

Fiber termination/getReturn is unrelated to evaluating match conditions and only the chosen result expression.
Generator send performs implicit startup and resumes a yield; foreach uses a cursor independent of an array's internal pointer.
Delegated exception recovery uses throw and resumed yields; delegated return composition uses normal exhaustion and return values.
